rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Refactor Graph Merging Logic from merge_graphs.py
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the graph merging logic from `merge_graphs.py`. The logic will be moved into a new `GraphMerger` class in `gbad_core/graph_merger.py`.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def consolidate_rdf_files(input_dir, output_file): """ Read all supported RDF files in a directory and combine them into a single N-Quads file. """ # ... def create_named_graph_uri_from_file(file_path: Path, graph_uri_path: URIRef): # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `GraphMerger` Class in `gbad_core/graph_merger.py`:** - The `__init__` method will take a configuration object. 2. **Implement `merge()` Method:** - This method will take a list of file paths or `rdflib.Graph` objects. - It will iterate through the list, parsing each file into an `rdflib.Dataset`. - For each file, it will call a private method, e.g., `_create_named_graph_uri`, to generate a named graph URI. - It will then merge all the triples/quads into a single `rdflib.Dataset` and return it. 3. **Implement `_create_named_graph_uri()` Method:** - This private method will contain the logic for generating a named graph URI for each file, based on the configured provenance requirements (from TICKET-20).
